Danielle —

Appreciate the clear redlines and the fast turnaround. High level counter from Redwood below (thumbs for discussion with your legal):

1) Baseline uptime
- Hosted pilot (multi-tenant): Redwood standard is 99.95% monthly uptime. For pilot customers we can discuss a temporary 99.90% concession for the first 3 months, but our recommendation is 99.95% as the standard going forward to avoid operational mismatches.

2) Remedy (monthly credit) — Redwood suggested framework (excerpt):
- 99.95% — no credit
- 99.90% to 99.50% — 5% of monthly fees per bucket (pro-rated by severity window)
- <99.50% — 25% of monthly fees for the month (subject to monthly cap)
- Monthly cap: we typically cap remedies at 1.5x monthly service fees for pilot agreements to limit one-off exposure.

3) Maintenance carveouts
- We can accommodate scheduled maintenance with 7 days notice and will target a max 8 hours/month for non-critical infra work. Emergency maintenance will be notified ASAP and is treated separately.

I attached a lightweight worksheet that models the remedy math across example spends to make the impact transparent (Service-Credit-Worksheet.xlsx).

If this looks directionally acceptable, next step: Ben loop in Legal for redline alignment and Aditya to confirm that the cap and maintenance carveouts are OK from an operational perspective.

Best,
